title: Software Engineer
description:
**Description**

**Leidos** is seeking an experienced **Software Engineer** to join the **Air Traffic Business** to support the design, development, integration and delivery of modern software solutions at the integration center in **Pune, India.** This role is ideal for a well-rounded software developer who brings strong traditional software engineering fundamentals along with experience or interest in developing and integrating AI-enabled capabilities.

The Software Engineer will work as part of an Agile development team to build scalable, secure, and reliable applications while leveraging modern development practices, cloud technologies, automation, and emerging artificial intelligence tools and frameworks.

**Primary Responsibilities**

  

* Responsible for software development activities both individually and as a member of a team, including writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining source code within an Agile environment.
* Collaborate with software engineers, systems engineers, data scientists, product owners, and other technical stakeholders to translate requirements into working software.
* Work within Agile/Scrum development environments and participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design discussions.
* Participate throughout the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications and services.
* Develop software using modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, C#, or similar technologies.
* Develop automated unit, integration, and system tests to ensure software quality and reliability.
* Utilize modern DevOps and CI/CD practices to automate software builds, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Troubleshoot complex software issues and continuously improve application performance, scalability, maintainability, and security.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, reliability, security, and performance

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline with relevant professional software development experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 2+ years of relevant experience or a Master’s Degree
* Fluent in English (both verbal and written) to effectively collaborate with team members and present reports and status.
* Professional experience developing software using one or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or C#.
* Experience with object-oriented programming, software design principles, algorithms, data structures, and source control tools such as Git.
* Experience developing or integrating APIs, web services, microservices, or distributed applications.
* Experience with modern software development methodologies and the SDLC.
* Experience with Linux environments (Red Hat), virtual machines, and hypervisors
* Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Understanding of cloud-based application development using AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Exposure to or experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-enabled application development.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in the aviation industry or a similar high-tech field is a plus.
* Experience working in a global or multicultural environment is a plus
* Experience developing cloud-native applications and working with cloud-based AI services.
* Experience developing software in highly secure, regulated, mission-critical, or enterprise environments.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

**Pay Range:**
--------------

Pay Range -

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

**About Leidos**

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

title: Power Platform Developer
description:
**Senior Data Integration**

* Experience: **5+ Years**
* Work location: **Pune**
* **Immediate joiners only. Please mention LWD in your application, if serving NP.**

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Senior Data Integration (PowerPlatform) Developer** to lead the design, development, and optimisation of enterprise data integration solutions using Microsoft Power Platform Dataflows. The successful candidate will be responsible for building scalable, reusable, and governed data preparation and transformation processes that serve as the foundation for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence across the organisation.

This role requires deep expertise in Power Platform Dataflows, Power Query (M), SQL development, ETL processes, and Power BI, with a strong focus on delivering high-quality, trusted data assets for business consumption.

The ideal candidate is a Power Platform Dataflows specialist who has extensive experience building and managing enterprise data transformation pipelines using the Microsoft ecosystem. They possess strong SQL and ETL capabilities and can leverage Power BI to deliver meaningful business insights built on trusted, governed data assets. This individual is comfortable working with both technical teams and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibility:**

· Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade Power Platform Dataflows.

· Build reusable and scalable data ingestion, cleansing, transformation, and enrichment processes.

· Develop complex data transformation logic using Power Query (M Language).

· Establish and maintain dataflow architecture, standards, governance, and best practices.

· Optimise dataflow performance, refresh schedules, and data lineage.

· Integrate data from multiple sources including Dataverse, SQL databases, APIs, SharePoint, and cloud platforms.

· Troubleshoot and resolve data quality, refresh, and performance issues.

· Ensure consistency, reliability, and governance of shared data assets.

· Develop and optimise complex T-SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and functions.

· Design and maintain reporting and analytical data structures.

· Perform query tuning and performance optimisation.

· Support data model development and database administration activities.

· Work closely with business and technical teams to translate data requirements into efficient database solutions.

· Develop and maintain Power BI datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and reports.

· Create meaningful visualisations and KPI reporting solutions.

· Develop DAX measures and calculations.

· Implement data security and Row-Level Security (RLS).

· Support self-service reporting capabilities across business teams.

· Document data movement processes and technical specifications.

**Mandatory Skills:**

· 5+ years of experience in Data Integration, & Data Engineering roles.

· Strong hands-on experience with:

o Power Platform Dataflows

o Power BI Dataflows

o Microsoft Dataverse

o Power Query (M Language)

o SQL Server and T-SQL

o ETL/ELT Design and Development

· Strong experience with Dataverse or Common Data Service.

· Experience integrating data from multiple sources including Dataverse, SQL Server, APIs, SharePoint, cloud platforms, and third-party applications.

· Strong understanding of data modelling principles and data warehousing concepts.

· Strong troubleshooting and performance optimisation skills.

· Comfortable contributing to code reviews, writing technical documentation, and participating in design sessions.

· Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

· Good communication skills – proficiency in English a must.

**Preferred Skills:**

· Microsoft Fabric Dataflows Gen2 /Gen1

· Azure Data Factory

· Dataverse

· SSIS

· Power BI

· Azure Synapse Analytics

· Experience with enterprise ETL/data integration tools such as: SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and Informatica PowerCenter / Informatica Cloud

· Experience using Git, Azure DevOps, or other version control tools.

· Familiarity with agile environments (e.g., using Jira, Azure Boards).

Pay: Up to ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?
* What is your notice period? Are you an immediate joiner?

Experience:

* Power Platform: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Power Platform & Copilot Developer
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

**Role Summary**
----------------

The **Power Platform & Copilot Developer** leads the design, delivery, and scaling of **enterprise AI agents, chatbots, and low-code solutions** using **Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Power Platform, Agent OS, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure AI Search** to support **LCS strategic business use cases** .

This role serves as a **technical and functional lead** , providing architectural guidance, governance oversight, and mentorship while ensuring measurable business outcomes from AI investments.

The role partners closely with business leaders, AI governance teams, and platform stakeholders to establish a **scalable, governed low-code and agentic AI operating model** , build Copilot Studio SME capability, and drive adoption across LCS.

We are hiring for **Pune and Noida** locations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **AI & Copilot Technical Leadership**

* Lead the **end-to-end architecture, design, and delivery** of Copilot Studio solutions, AI agents, and chatbots.
* Define **conversational and agentic AI patterns** , standards, and reusable frameworks for enterprise adoption.
* Leverage **Agent OS and Azure AI Foundry** for agent orchestration and advanced AI use cases.
* Design enterprise knowledge and **RAG solutions using Azure AI Search** where applicable.
* Review solution designs to ensure scalability, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Drive continuous improvement of AI agents based on usage analytics, feedback, and business outcomes.

### **Power Platform Solution Architecture**

* Lead development of complex **Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Copilot Studio solutions** .
* Establish best practices for **low-code/pro-code extensibility, integrations, APIs, and AI services** .
* Enable integration across **Power Platform, Agent OS, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and enterprise systems** .
* Ensure alignment with enterprise application architecture and data strategies.

### **Governance, Security & Compliance**

* Own and enforce **governance standards** for Copilot, Power Platform, and enterprise AI solutions.
* Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure **Responsible AI, data protection, and audit readiness** .
* Guide environment strategy, DLP policies, access controls, and solution lifecycle management.

### **Capability Building & Team Enablement**

* Act as a **Copilot Studio SME and mentor** , cross-training Power Platform developers into AI solution builders.
* Build team capability across **Copilot Studio, Agent OS, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and RAG** .
* Support hiring, onboarding, and enablement of incremental Copilot development capacity.
* Contribute to a **Center of Excellence / RCC delivery model** , defining intake, prioritization, KPIs, and capacity planning.

### **Stakeholder & Program Leadership**

* Partner with business owners and AI leadership to identify, prioritize, and roadmap high-value AI use cases.
* Provide executive-level updates on progress, risks, ROI, and adoption metrics.
* Represent the Copilot and low-code AI capability in enterprise forums such as AI2.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* Advanced hands-on experience with **Microsoft Power Platform** (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse).
* Strong experience designing and delivering solutions using **Microsoft Copilot Studio** .
* Experience with **AI agents, agentic workflows, and enterprise AI integration patterns** .
* Working knowledge of **Agent OS and Azure AI Foundry** .
* Understanding of **Azure AI Search, RAG, and enterprise knowledge grounding** .
* Proven experience leading **enterprise-scale low-code or AI initiatives** .
* Strong understanding of **conversational AI design, UX, and performance optimization** .
* Experience with governance, security, Responsible AI, and compliance in enterprise environments.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Microsoft certifications in **Power Platform, Copilot Studio, or Azure AI** .
* Hands-on exposure to **Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, and RAG architectures** .
* Experience with **agent orchestration and multi-agent architectures** .
* Experience operating within a **Center of Excellence (CoE) or shared services model** .
* Experience defining and tracking **KPIs, ROI, and adoption metrics** for AI solutions.
* Familiarity with change management and enterprise adoption strategies.

**Success Measures**

Pune

**About Us**

We empower enterprises globally through intelligent, creative, and insightful services for data integration, data analytics and data visualization.

Hoonartek is a leader in enterprise transformation, data engineering and an acknowledged world-class Ab Initio delivery partner.

Using centuries of cumulative experience, research and leadership, we help our clients eliminate the complexities & risk of legacy modernization and safely deliver big data hubs, operational data integration, business intelligence, risk & compliance solutions and traditional data warehouses & marts.

At Hoonartek, we work to ensure that our customers, partners and employees all benefit from our unstinting commitment to delivery, quality and value. Hoonartek is increasingly the choice for customers seeking a trusted partner of vision, value and integrity

  
  

**How We Work?**

  

Define, Design and Deliver (D3) is our in-house delivery philosophy. It’s culled from agile and rapid methodologies and focused on ‘just enough design’. We embrace this philosophy in everything we do, leading to numerous client success stories and indeed to our own success.

We embrace change, empowering and trusting our people and building long and valuable relationships with our employees, our customers and our partners. We work flexibly, even adopting traditional/waterfall methods where circumstances demand it. At Hoonartek, the focus is always on delivery and value.

**Job Requirement**

### **Role Summary**

We are looking for a Databricks Apps Developer to design, develop, deploy and support secure data applications on the Databricks platform. The role will cover Databricks Apps, MIS and operational reporting interfaces, Lakehouse data integration, application security, deployment automation and production support.

Databricks Apps supports Python and Node.js development using frameworks such as Streamlit, Dash, Gradio, React and Express. Applications can connect to Databricks SQL and Unity Catalog-governed data and use OAuth-based authentication.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop user-facing applications using Databricks Apps.
* Build MIS, reporting, workflow, data-entry and operational interfaces.
* Develop frontend components using Streamlit, Dash, Gradio or React.
* Develop backend services and APIs using Python, Flask, FastAPI, Node.js or Express.
* Connect applications to Databricks SQL Warehouses, Delta Lake tables and Unity Catalog.
* Implement parameterised SQL queries, filters, drill-downs, exports and data-entry workflows.
* Integrate applications with Databricks Jobs, Workflows, APIs, Model Serving and external services.
* Implement application-level and user-level authentication using OAuth and service principals.
* Ensure that applications respect Unity Catalog permissions, row-level filters and column masking.
* Configure application resources, environment variables, secrets, permissions and network connectivity.
* Develop unit tests, integration tests and security validations.
* Deploy applications across Development, UAT and Production environments.
* Establish CI/CD using Git, Databricks CLI and Databricks Asset Bundles.
* Monitor application logs, performance, usage, failures and compute consumption.
* Troubleshoot Databricks Apps, MIS reports, SQL queries, APIs and application-performance issues.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
* Prepare technical design, deployment, support and operational documentation.
* Work with business, MIS, data engineering, governance, security and infrastructure teams.

### **Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks Apps or application development on Databricks.
* Streamlit, Dash, Gradio, Flask or FastAPI.
* Strong SQL and Databricks SQL experience.
* Delta Lake and Lakehouse architecture.
* Unity Catalog, permissions and data governance.
* Databricks SDK, CLI and REST APIs.
* OAuth 2.0, service principals and role-based access control.
* Git and CI/CD deployment practices.
* HTML, CSS and JavaScript fundamentals.
* Application logging, debugging and performance tuning.
* Experience working with AWS-hosted Databricks environments.

### **Preferred Skills**

* React, Angular, Svelte, Node.js or Express.
* MIS and regulatory-reporting application development.
* Databricks Workflows and Jobs.
* AI/BI Dashboards and Genie integration.
* Model Serving, Vector Search or RAG application development.
* Testing frameworks such as Pytest, Playwright or Selenium.

description:
Want to be on a team that full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate? Want to make an impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team does just that. Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS.

  

SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer to help build a new cloud-based SaaS identity analytics product. We are looking for well-rounded backend or full stack engineers who are passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable microservices and infrastructure for SaaS products.

As one of the first members on the team, you will be integral in building this product and will be part of an agile team that is in startup mode. This is a unique opportunity to build something from scratch but have the backing of an organization that has the muscle to take it to market quickly, with a very satisfied customer base.

Responsibilities

* Deliver efficient, maintainable, robust Java based microservices.
* Produce designs and rough estimates, and implement features based on product requirements.
* Collaborate with peers on designs, code reviews, and testing.
Produce unit and end-to-end tests to improve code quality and maximize code coverage for new and existing features.  

  

**Requirements**

* **9-14 yearss** of experience in **Java / GO** -based backend development.
* Strong knowledge in developing server-side, Object-Oriented Programming and Spring Boot framework
* Experience in designing, implementing RESTful/GraphQL APIs for an API-first application architecture.
* Experience using cloud-native technologies from AWS/other cloud providers.
* Experience developing microservices in multi-tenant SaaS application.
* Experience using SQL/NoSQL, EKS, Kafka, Redis
* Experience using monitoring, alerting, visualization tools like Prometheus, Grafana
* Experience with AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude.
* Experience working with remote teams
Great communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills  

**Desired**

* Professional experience in design/implementation of event-driven architecture.
Experience writing software applications in Go  

**What success looks like in the role**

  

**Within the first 30 days you will:**

* Onboard into your new role, get familiar with our product offering and technology, proactively meet peers and stakeholders, set up your development environment.

* Seek to deeply understand business problems or common engineering challenges and develop feature and unit test it.

**By 90 days:**

* Proactively implement different enhancements, defect fixes by interacting independently with different (sometimes *many* ) stakeholders, architects and members of your team.
* Take a committed approach to contributing to different projects development alongside less experienced engineers on your team—there’s no room for ivory towers here.
* Is able to provide 12x7 on-call support during their day.

**By 6 months:**

* Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to estimate and develop small to medium complexity features more independently.
* Lead projects with small group of 3-4 members. Participate in resource planning, backlog refinement activity.
* Occasionally serve as an analysis expert during escalations of systems issues that have evaded the ability of less experienced engineers to solve in a timely manner.

You will be deeply involved in leading the development of our web based offering including collaborating across the organization with architects, subject matter experts, product managers and other software developers. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to represent abstract challenges in the form of system architecture & design
* Work in an agile, collaborative environment where there is collective ownership of the code.
* Work in a continuous integration mode and always strive for continuous delivery.

**Qualifications & Skills required**

The role requires a talented, self-directed, and self-motivated individual with a strong work ethic and the following qualifications, experience, and skills:

* Minimum 3 to 6 years’ professional software development experience in developing large scale, mission critical and high availability enterprise level applications
* Design and develop scalable, extensible, reliable, and maintainable Java-based backend services and web applications.
* Build and maintain RESTful and SOAP-based web services and microservices architectures using Spring Boot and Spring MVC.

* Write clean, modular, and testable code with comprehensive unit and integration test coverage (JUnit, Mockito).
* Develop and maintain data access layers using Hibernate/JPA, with proficiency in both MySQL and SQL Server.
* Participate in end-to-end software lifecycle: requirements analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment.

* Provide application support including log analysis, root cause identification, and resolution within defined SLAs.

* Maintain 24/7 on-call readiness during scheduled rotations, weekends, and holidays.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting across the full application stack — JVM, application server, database, and cloud layers.
* Design and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and database schemas in MySQL and SQL Server.
* Perform database performance tuning, indexing strategies, and query optimization.
* Collaborate with DBAs on schema migrations, upgrade planning, and capacity management.
* Work in an agile (Scrum/Kanban) environment with collective code ownership and continuous integration/delivery practices.
* Actively participate in sprint planning, code reviews, retrospectives, and technical design sessions.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, QA, and front-end engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions.

**The Team**

**Pitney Bowes** (NYSE: PBI) is a global shipping and mailing company that provides technology, logistics, and financial services to more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500. Small business, retail, enterprise, and government clients around the world rely on Pitney Bowes to remove the complexity of sending mail and parcels. **Job Summary**

***(****A brief overview of the role, its purpose, and key responsibilities.)*

The Data Scientist will be responsible for analyzing data, building machine learning models, and generating insights to support cybersecurity and product use cases. The role involves data preprocessing, feature engineering, model development, model evaluation, and working with engineering teams to integrate ML outputs into applications, dashboards, or workflows.

The candidate should have hands-on experience in Python, SQL, machine learning techniques, data analysis, and basic MLOps concepts. Experience in cybersecurity analytics, anomaly detection, user behavior analytics, or AI/ML-based product development will be an added advantage.

  

**Job Responsibilities**

*(The key tasks and duties you will be expected to perform in this role.)*

* Understand business and product requirements and convert them into data analysis or machine learning tasks.

* Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze structured and unstructured datasets from different sources.

* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and useful insights.

* Build and validate machine learning models for classification, prediction, clustering, anomaly detection, and risk scoring use cases.

* Perform feature engineering to improve model accuracy and business relevance.

* Evaluate model performance using suitable metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and false positive rate.

* Work with engineering teams to integrate ML models or analytical outputs into products, APIs, reports, or dashboards.

* Support model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and performance tracking using basic MLOps practices.

* Prepare reports, visualizations, and documentation to communicate findings and model outcomes.

* Collaborate with product, engineering, security, and data teams to deliver practical data-driven solutions.

* Maintain proper documentation for datasets, model logic, assumptions, evaluation results, and limitations.

* Continuously learn and apply relevant AI/ML techniques, tools, and frameworks based on project needs.

* Strong communication, troubleshooting, co-ordination and interpersonal skill

  

**Must Have Skills**  
*(The essential skills and expertise required to succeed in this role.)*

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent.

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI/ML solution development.

* Strong programming skills in **Python**.

* Good knowledge of **SQL** and experience working with structured/unstructured datasets.

* Hands-on experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, and model evaluation.

* Good understanding of ML algorithms such as classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and predictive modeling.

* Experience with Python libraries such as **Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn**, and visualization libraries.

* Basic understanding of **MLOps**, including model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and versioning.

* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and present insights clearly.

* Good communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  

**Nice / Good to have skills**

*(Additional skills that are not mandatory but give you an added advantage in this role.)*

* Exposure to cybersecurity

* Experience with dashboards or visualization tools such as Power BI, Kibana, or Grafana

--------------------

**Job Title: Software Development Engineer in Test**

**Corporate Title: Vice President**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Role Description**

This role is responsible for owning product quality and defining and implementing AI-first engineering and automated validation solutions for the Account Information Platform. The candidate should demonstrate strong software engineering expertise, excellent problem-solving skills, and an agents-first mindset, with the ability to apply agentic AI approaches to testing while leading quality engineering through hands-on development. The candidate is expected to:

* Bring an AI-first and agent-first approach to quality engineering by identifying, designing, and implementing agentic AI use cases across test design, automation, execution, analysis, and reporting.
* Own quality for the Account Information Platform, including test strategy, risk assessment, regression execution, release-readiness reporting, and quality sign-off for production releases.
* Contribute as a hands-on senior engineer involved in analysis, design, and code reviews, coding, automation framework development, and release activities.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, the Tribe Lead, Product Owner, architects, developers, SRE, and platform teams to successfully deliver business outcomes.
* Acquire strong functional knowledge of account-information capabilities, customer journeys, data flows, and services delivered through the Account Information Platform.
Demonstrate ownership, inspire others, apply innovative thinking and a growth mindset, and collaborate across teams for success.  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Lead an AI-first, agents-first approach to testing by identifying and implementing agentic AI patterns for requirements analysis, test design, code generation, test-data preparation, execution orchestration, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and quality reporting.
* Define the automation strategy, framework design, engineering standards, and scalable patterns for validating account-information journeys across web interfaces, APIs, services, data flows, and integrations.
* Design and develop critical automation components, reusable libraries, utilities, AI-enabled testing tools, and test agents using Java, Selenium, Playwright, and scripting languages; establish high standards through robust code and design reviews.
* Partner with developers and architects to embed testability, observability, security, reliability, and automated quality gates throughout design, development, CI/CD, release, and production validation.
* Build and maintain reliable risk-based regression capabilities, drive effective execution and result analysis, and use engineering metrics and root-cause analysis to reduce escaped defects, flaky tests, and repetitive manual effort.
* Coach engineers in AI-enabled testing, modern development and test practices, foster continuous learning, and build a culture where quality is an engineering responsibility shared across the product team.
Translate quality risks, AI-enabled testing opportunities, regression outcomes, and release-readiness evidence into clear business terms for product, technology, and executive stakeholders.  

**Your skills and experience**

* Proven ability to define and implement agentic AI approaches for software testing, including the use of autonomous or semi-autonomous agents for test design, automation development, execution orchestration, defect triage, analysis, and reporting.
* Strong agents-first mindset, with the ability to identify where AI agents can improve coverage, engineering productivity, decision-making, and delivery confidence while retaining appropriate human oversight and control.
* Practical experience with generative AI, coding assistants, prompt engineering, agent workflows, tool integration, and evaluation of AI-generated code and test artefacts for correctness, security, maintainability, and responsible use.
* Minimum 14 years of IT industry experience, with substantial hands-on experience in software development, test engineering, product-quality ownership, and delivery of complex business-critical systems.
* Expert-level programming skills in Java, with the ability to develop clean, maintainable, reusable, and production-quality automation code and engineering frameworks.
* Strong hands-on experience with Selenium and Playwright for browser and end-to-end automation, including framework design, parallel execution, cross-browser validation, and test reliability.
* Strong scripting capability using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Shell scripting for automation, AI-agent tooling, data preparation, and engineering productivity.
* Deep experience in API and service-level automation using tools and libraries such as REST Assured, with a sound understanding of REST, JSON, XML, authentication, and integration testing.
* Demonstrated experience owning test strategy, risk-based regression scope and execution, defect governance, release-readiness assessment, and quality sign-off for production releases.
* Strong knowledge of software design principles, object-oriented programming, debugging, code reviews, and engineering practices that support scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Experience integrating automated validation and AI-enabled testing capabilities into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions, with good knowledge of Git and build tools such as Maven or Gradle.
* Experience with test environments, test data management, databases and SQL, service virtualisation or mocking, observability tools, and evidence-based quality reporting.
* Good understanding of performance, security, accessibility, reliability, contract, and risk-based testing, with the ability to incorporate relevant checks into engineering workflows.
Proven technical leadership, stakeholder management, mentoring, and communication skills, combined with the ability to remain a hands-on individual contributor.  

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

Please visit our company website for further information:

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**

*Platform architecture and evolution*

**Function -** Infrastructure & Operations

**Coverage -** Across all clients

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer is the senior technical owner of Merkle Denmark’s cloud platform architecture. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the cloud foundations, guardrails, and platform capabilities that underpin client operations — ensuring environments are reliable, secure, and well-governed.

The role is a hands-on specialist position. It sets the direction for how cloud infrastructure is designed, built, and hardened across client accounts, and provides deep technical input on complex incidents, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions. People leadership, resource allocation, and day-to-day team direction sit with the Engineering Director.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineering**

* Architect and build cloud foundations and platform capabilities across client environments.
* Define secure-by-design patterns, guardrails, and platform standards for Cloud Operations to operate within.
* Design resilience and continuity architecture, including backup/restore strategy and disaster recovery.
* Own and evolve infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices and tooling standards.
* Drive continuous improvement of the platform approach, ensuring it evolves with client needs and industry practice.
* Provide specialist guidance to Cloud Operations Engineers during complex incident investigations, major changes, and architecture-impacting decisions.
* Assess and respond to critical CVEs and security advisory items, coordinating with dentsu EMEA security where required.

**Operational Governance**

* Define platform-level patterns that support incident management, change management, SLA governance, and on-call practice.
* Provide senior technical input on P1/critical incidents and client-impacting situations where infrastructure or platform expertise is needed.
* Ensure platform ownership responsibilities are clearly defined and applied — Cloud Ops owns production stability; Cloud Infrastructure owns design and evolution.
* Maintain platform design standards that support audit-readiness, NIS2, and client contractual obligations.
* Contribute to operational reporting quality, including platform health signals and SLA-relevant metrics.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as senior technical point of contact for client escalations requiring infrastructure or platform expertise.
* Collaborate with Project Managers and delivery teams on change planning, release readiness, and deployment governance.
* Contribute to account-level technical conversations, including architecture reviews and SLA design.
* Support pre-sales and proposal work where infrastructure architecture or managed operations expertise is required.

**Must-Have Skillset –**
------------------------

  

**Cloud Infrastructure Engineer -Over 8+ years of exp**
-------------------------------------------------------

  

* **Cloud Architecture Expertise** (Azure, AWS, or GCP)Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud platforms Define platform guardrails and architecture standards
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**Strong hands-on experience with **Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or equivalent** Building and maintaining automated infrastructure deployments
* **Cloud Security & Compliance** Secure-by-design architecture principles Platform-level security controls, vulnerability/CVE management Understanding of compliance frameworks, governance, and audit requirements
* **Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity** Design and implementation of DR, backup, restore, and resilience strategiesHigh availability and fault-tolerant architecture design
* **ITIL / ITSM Knowledge** Strong understanding of: Incident Management hange Management Problem Management SLA Governance
* **Critical Incident & Escalation Management** Experience providing technical leadership during P1/P0 incidents Root cause analysis and architecture-level problem resolution
* **Operational Governance** Define platform standards, operational patterns, and best practices Support incident, change, and service management frameworks
* **Client & Stakeholder Management** Act as senior technical advisor during architecture reviews Experience working directly with enterprise clients and stakeholders
* **Multi-Cloud & Managed Services Experience** Experience in professional services, managed operations, or multi-client environments Understanding of contractual obligations, SLAs, and service delivery models
* **Technical Skills** Networking (VNet/VPC, VPN, Load Balancers, DNS, Firewalls)Windows/Linux Server Administration Containers & Kubernetes Monitoring & Observability tools Automation and Scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)
* Experience with NIS2, GDPR, and data processing regulations
* Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or CI/CD expertise
* Excellent written and verbal English communication Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders

**Nice-to-Have**
----------------

* Danish language proficiency
* Public sector or enterprise platform experience

**Working Context**
-------------------

The role sits within the Merkle Denmark engineering organisation, reporting to the CTO and working closely with the Engineering Director, Infrastructure & Operations. The Infrastructure & Operations function is distributed across Denmark, Bulgaria, India, and the Philippines, and operates across multiple client accounts including public sector and enterprise digital platforms.

The function works within a ticket-first, evidence-driven operational model. Production is owned by Cloud Operations; platform architecture and guardrails are owned by Cloud Infrastructure Engineering. This separation of duties supports governance, auditability, and clear accountability.

Merkle

Full time

title: Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
description:
Staff Engineer – AI in Embedded Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Location: Pune, India

  
  

**About GF**
------------

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

  

**Introduction**
----------------

GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained.

  
  

**Your Job**
------------

* Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities.
* Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation.
* Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data.
* Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement.
* Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts.
* Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance.
* Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks.
* Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption.
* Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams.
  

  

**Other Responsibilities**
--------------------------

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
* Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements.
* Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **4 to** **8 years** of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms.
* Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development.
* Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies.
* Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments.
* Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments.
* Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration.
* Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams.
* Ability to travel up to 10% as required.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* Experience with RISC-V processor architectures, toolchains, and ecosystem development.
* Knowledge of AUTOSAR, safety-critical systems, and functional safety standards including ISO 26262.
* Experience developing IDE plugins, engineering productivity tools, or software developer platforms.
* Experience with MLOps infrastructure, GPU-based training and inference environments, and enterprise AI deployments.
* Exposure to static code analysis, compiler technologies, program analysis, or code intelligence platforms.
* Expertise in AI governance, security, model evaluation, traceability, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience publishing research, contributing to open-source projects, or providing technical thought leadership in AI-assisted engineering.
* Experience working with semiconductor product development, post-silicon validation, or firmware platform teams.

**Senior Business Intelligence Engineer**

**About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.**

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.  
  
  
Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer who can turn complex data into simple and meaningful business insights.

Location: Pune, India

You will work closely with business teams, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other technology teams to understand business needs and build scalable reporting and analytics solutions.

The role requires strong hands-on experience in Power BI, SQL, Snowflake, and MicroStrategy, along with a good understanding of Databricks and modern data platforms.

We are also looking for someone who understands how Business Intelligence is evolving, especially how strong semantic models can support AI-assisted and natural-language analytics.

**Impact of the Role**

• Understand the business meaning behind the data, ask the right questions, and build reporting solutions that business teams can trust and easily use.

• Take ownership, solve complex reporting problems, work directly with business and engineering teams, and help improve the overall BI platform.

• Contribute to how business users will interact with enterprise data in the future as Business Intelligence continues to move toward semantic models, conversational analytics, and AI-assisted reporting.

**Technology Platforms You Will Work On**

• Power BI, DAX, Power Query, Power BI Copilot, and Microsoft Fabric

• MicroStrategy, Intelligent Cubes, REST APIs, SDK-based integrations, and System Manager

• SQL, Snowflake, Azure Databricks, and Delta Lake

• Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Blob Storage, and Azure DevOps

• Python, PySpark, and Apache Spark

• Apache Kafka and other streaming technologies

• AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and natural-language analytics

• CI/CD pipelines and Dev, QA, and Production environments

**Key Responsibilities**

• Design and develop scalable Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.

• Build and maintain business semantic models with clear measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and business definitions.

• Develop and maintain MicroStrategy reports, dashboards, scorecards, and reporting solutions.

• Design and work with MicroStrategy schema objects such as attributes, facts, hierarchies, relationships, metrics, filters, prompts, consolidations, and custom groups.

• Work with MicroStrategy projects, Intelligent Cubes, caching, aggregate tables, and VLDB settings to improve reporting performance.

• Write and optimize complex SQL queries across large enterprise datasets.

• Work with Snowflake, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and other enterprise data platforms.

• Understand business requirements and convert them into clear data models, semantic models, reports, and analytical solutions.

• Build solutions using good data modeling practices, including fact and dimension models, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.

• Improve dashboard, SQL, semantic model, and reporting performance.

• Work with business teams to define and maintain consistent business metrics, KPIs, definitions, and calculation logic.

• Understand how AI agents and natural-language analytics can work on top of a governed business semantic layer.

• Add meaningful metadata, descriptions, synonyms, relationships, and business context so AI-based analytics can interpret business questions correctly.

• Work with Data Engineering and AI teams to ensure AI-assisted analytics uses trusted and governed enterprise data.

• Ensure data quality, security, access control, lineage, and consistency across reporting solutions.

• Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide long-term fixes.

• Support deployments and production releases across reporting platforms.

• Review solutions developed by other engineers and help maintain good engineering standards.

• Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge and best practices across the team.

• Take ownership of solutions from requirement understanding through design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

**Qualifications**

• 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a similar role.

• Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including semantic models, DAX, Power Query, and performance optimization.

• Strong hands-on experience with MicroStrategy reporting and dashboard development.

• Good understanding of MicroStrategy schema objects, metrics, filters, prompts, Intelligent Cubes, caching, and performance tuning.

• Strong SQL skills with experience working with large enterprise datasets.

• Good hands-on experience with Snowflake.

• Experience working with Azure Databricks / Delta Lake or similar modern data platforms.

• Strong understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including fact tables, dimensions, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.

• Good understanding of semantic layers, business measures, KPIs, metadata, and relationships.

• Experience with report and query performance optimization.

• Understanding of data quality, governance, security, lineage, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

• Ability to troubleshoot complex reporting and data issues independently.

• Ability to work directly with business users and translate business questions into technical solutions.

• Good communication and problem-solving skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.

Good to Have

• Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for building simple ETL/ELT and reporting pipelines.

• Ability to use ADF to move data from source systems to Azure Blob Storage or other cloud storage.

• Understanding of ADF linked services, parameters, variables, and environment-specific configurations.

• Exposure to deploying ADF resources across Dev, QA, and Production using Azure DevOps and CI/CD.

• Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI Copilot.

• Basic understanding of how LLMs, RAG, and AI agents can work with enterprise data and business semantic models.

• Experience with Python, PySpark or Apache Spark.

• Exposure to Apache Kafka or other streaming technologies.

• Experience with MicroStrategy REST APIs or SDK-based integrations.

• Exposure to MicroStrategy administration or System Manager activities.

• Experience working with retail, e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, customer, or finance data would be an advantage.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

• Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.

• Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.

• Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.

• Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.

• Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

  

**Williams-Sonoma India Pvt. Ltd.**

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. description:
**Job title: Senior Software Engineer**

**About SailPoint:**

SailPoint is the leader in identity security for the cloud enterprise. Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less.
  
  
**About the role:**

Want to be on a team that full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate? Want to make an impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team does just that. Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS.

SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer with a strong API(REST/GraphQL) development/design background with a flair for programming in java (and Go desired) with a demonstrated history of learning, passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable, observable microservices for enterprise-grade, multi-tenant SaaS products. The position will be part of Identity Security Cloud Business Services group that develops governance features - Access Certifications, Access Request & Approvals, Password Management, Separation of Duties, Identity/Account Refresh and Provisioning to connect and centrally control access to every application. As part of this team, we are defining the API management strategy for the range of SaaS products, and bring uniformity to the API creation across all teams, adopting diverse cloud-native technologies (persistence, messaging, analytical processing – to name a few) and enabling the product to scale seamlessly while providing a performant user experience. You'll work with teams that are passionate about continuous improvement and agility in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the planning, design, construction, and reviewing the construction of APIs.
* Drive the design, implementation, and deployment of efficient, maintainable, robust microservices to deliver medium-to-high complexity features.
* As a member of the API strategy team, you will collaborate with the services team and help your stakeholders follow the organization's strategy for designing, building, and maintaining APIs.
* Produce designs and rough estimates, and implement features based on product requirements.
* Collaborate with peers on designs, code reviews, and testing.
Produce unit and end-to-end tests to improve code quality and maximize code coverage for new and existing features.  

  

**Requirements**

* **6+ years** of experience in **Java** -based backend development.
* Strong knowledge in developing server-side, Object-Oriented Programming and Spring Boot framework
* Experience in designing, implementing RESTful/GraphQL APIs for an API-first application architecture.
* Experience using cloud-native technologies from AWS/other cloud providers.
* Experience developing microservices in multi-tenant SaaS application.
* Experience using SQL/NoSQL, EKS, Kafka, Redis
* Experience using monitoring, alerting, visualization tools like Prometheus, Grafana
* Experience with AI development tools such as Cursor or Claude.
* Experience working with remote teams
Great communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills  

**Desired**

* Professional experience in design/implementation of event-driven architecture.
Experience writing software applications in Go  

**What success looks like in the role**

  

**Within the first 30 days you will:**

* Onboard into your new role, get familiar with our product offering and technology, proactively meet peers and stakeholders, set up your development environment.

Seek to deeply understand business problems or common engineering challenges and develop feature and unit test it.  



**By 90 days:**

* Proactively implement different enhancements, defect fixes by interacting independently with different (sometimes *many* ) stakeholders, architects and members of your team.
* Take a committed approach to contributing to different projects development alongside less experienced engineers on your team—there’s no room for ivory towers here.
Is able to provide 12x7 on-call support during their day.  

**By 6 months:**

* Collaborates with Product Management and Engineering Manager to estimate and develop small to medium complexity features more independently.
* Lead projects with small group of 3-4 members. Participate in resource planning, backlog refinement activity.
* Occasionally serve as an analysis expert during escalations of systems issues that have evaded the ability of less experienced engineers to solve in a timely manner.
Share support of critical team systems by participating in calls with customers, learning the characteristics of currently running systems, and participating in improvements.  

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals.
  
  
Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

* Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.

title: Cloud Infrastructure & Agentic Architect (f/m/d)
description:
* Pune (IND)
* IT

* Published: 2026-10-13

**What do we do?**
------------------

**Introducing Thinkproject Platform**
  
  
Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies.

By combining information management expertise and in-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem.

**What your day will look like**
--------------------------------

**About the Role**
  
We are looking for a **Cloud Infrastructure & Agentic Architect (f/m/d)** to own the technical foundation of our cloud platform. You will maintain our service catalog, design architectural blueprints, establish the observability standard, and — most distinctively — bring hands-on LLM-driven tooling skills to a team actively shaping what the next generation of cloud operations looks like.

This is a senior individual-contributor role reporting to the **Cloud Architect Manager (who reports to the CIO)**, with direct CIO-adjacent visibility. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering and technology strategy, contributing to platform roadmap decisions — not just executing them. The team is small, ownership is total, and iteration cycles are short. You will be expected to resolve ambiguity, align expectations, and establish technical clarity across a diverse group of stakeholders.

**Time allocation (approximate):**
  
~40% LLM-driven tooling & workflow design | ~30% architecture & catalog governance | ~20%
  
observability | ~10% collaboration & documentation

**Key Responsibilities**
  
**Service Catalog & Platform Governance**

* Build and maintain a minimalistic, opinionated service catalog of approved cloud components across Google Cloud and Azure
* Apply a serverless-first, PaaS-first philosophy — challenge complexity and push back on
    
  unnecessary infrastructure sprawl
* For every approved catalog entry, deliver production-ready configuration: IaC, security baseline,observability hooks, and runbook
* Scrutinise every new component request and justify its addition in terms of cost, operational overhead, and platform alignment

**Cloud Architecture**

* Define, document, and govern cloud architectural blueprints across networking, compute, storage and data layers
* Design event-driven pipelines that trigger AI-assisted validation, drift detection, and deployment gates
* Serve as the technical authority on platform design decisions within your domain

**LLM-Driven Operations**

* Implement LLM-based automated deployment capabilities using tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code, or equivalent frameworks
* Design and operate infrastructure workflows augmented by AI agents — from deployment validation to configuration drift detection
* Stay ahead of the market in AI-assisted tooling and bring relevant innovations into the platform

**Observability**

* Define the observability standard: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, dashboards, and SLO/SLA frameworks
* Establish platform-level KPIs and ensure consistent adoption across engineering teams

**Collaboration**

* Partner with DevOps and Engineering teams to embed platform standards into delivery pipelines
* Partner with SecOps to integrate all controls and security requirements
* Document everything: blueprints, ADRs, runbooks, onboarding guides

**What you need to fulfill the role**
-------------------------------------

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
  
You have operated multi-cloud Kubernetes environments in production, built IaC pipelines with Terraform and have hands-on experience with LLM-driven tooling in real engineering workflows. Specifically:

* Proven cloud networking experience: firewalls, gateways, VPCs, VPNs, private service connect, and network security groups
* Strong, current proficiency across **Google Cloud Platform** (GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, VPC, Cloud Armor, Pub/Sub, Artifact Registry) and **Microsoft Azure**
* Proven IaC experience with **Terraform** (required); Ansible a strong plus
* **Proven hands-on LLM tooling experience**: must have used **OpenCode, Claude Code,** or equivalent AI-assisted coding/deployment agents in real engineering workflows
* **Kubernetes at scale:** demonstrated experience operating **AKS** (Azure Kubernetes Service) and **GKE** (Google Kubernetes Engine) — cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, and workload management
* Experience with **Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or similar cloud** model gardens
* Ability to proactively coordinate with stakeholders to remove ambiguity and build clarity in migration designs
* Experience in Agile/fast-iteration environments with high individual ownership

**Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* Knowledge of C5, SecNumCloud, ISO 27001, or equivalent cloud security frameworks
* FinOps — cost attribution, rightsizing, commitment strategies
* Prior experience in a SaaS product company at scale
* Platform engineering / SRE background

**Soft Skills**

* Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and form opinions before they become mainstream
* Strong problem-solving discipline: you reach for first principles, not familiarity
* Ownership mindset — you build it, you run it, you improve it
* Clear written and verbal communication: able to document decisions and explain them to non specialists
* Operates well under pressure and tight constraints — energised by hard problems
* Strong negotiation skills — fact-driven and data-driven: you argue with evidence, not opinion
* Highly collaborative: you build alignment across engineering, SecOps, and leadership

**What success looks like**

We target a mature and highly automated cloud foundation designed for modern enterprise SaaS. The long-term success of this role is defined by:

* **Robust Service Catalog & Governance:** An established service catalog baseline featuring approved, standardized cloud components with built-in compliance, IaC automation, and production-ready monitoring.
* **Enterprise-Wide Observability Adoption:** Broad deployment of unified platform-level observability standards across engineering teams, incorporating logging, distributed tracing, and clear SLA frameworks.
* **AI-Accelerated Workflows:** Active, production-ready LLM-driven deployment, validation, and configuration drift-detection pipelines to streamline system management.
* **Sustainable Architecture Blueprints:** Completed architectural blueprints and ADR documents defining the multi-cloud framework, paired with scalable FinOps cost tracking principles.

**You're probably NOT a fit if**

* You need a large team to delegate to before making decisions
* You prefer deep specialisation in a single cloud over breadth across two
* You're not actively following the LLM/AI tooling space
* You're looking for a role with clearly defined scope and minimal ambiguity

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Multicultural team across 7 countries (Germany, France, UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, Australia)
* Hybrid-first working
* Continuous learning & certification budget
* Open, inclusive, and high-ownership culture
* Learning programmes | Career growth | Leadership access

At Thinkproject, we run feedback cycles that are honest and frequent. We believe the best engineering cultures are built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership — not hierarchy. Our Pune team is a core part of a global organisation, collaborating across time zones with colleagues in Germany, France, the UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia.

**Lunch 'n' Learn Sessions I Women's Network I LGBTQIA+ Network I Coffee Chat Roulette I Free English Lessons I Thinkproject Academy I Social Events I Volunteering Activities I Open Forum with Leadership Team (Tp Café) I Hybrid working I Unlimited learning**
  
  
We are a passionate bunch here. To join Thinkproject is to shape what our company becomes. We take feedback from our staff very seriously and give them the tools they need to help us create our fantastic culture of mutual respect. We believe that investing in our staff is crucial to the success of our business.

**Your contact:**
-----------------

Mehal Mehta

**How to apply**
  
Submit your application at careers.thinkproject.com, including:

* Salary expectations
* Potential start date
* **A short write-up (max 300 words) on the most complex cloud infrastructure or LLM-driven** **workflow challenge you have solved — this is the most important part of your application**

Working at thinkproject.com - **think career. think ahead.**

Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing technology & professional services solutions company and industry leader in energy transformation.

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the energy industry. Throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior NetSuite Developer to join our dynamic IT team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the development, customization, and maintenance of our NetSuite ERP system. This role requires a deep understanding of NetSuite's architecture, extensive experience with SuiteScript, and the ability to lead technical projects from conception to implementation. The ideal candidate will also bring a forward-thinking mindset, leveraging AI tools and technologies to drive efficiency and innovation.

* Leverage AI/ML APIs (such as OpenAI, Claude, or similar) to extend NetSuite functionality and build intelligent, data-driven features.

**System Customization & Maintenance:**

* Customize and maintain NetSuite's forms, fields, records, and workflows to meet organizational requirements.
* Provide ongoing support and system administration to ensure NetSuite functionality aligns with business processes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve any system issues in a timely manner.

**Project Management:**

* Lead and manage technical projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements.
* Ensure project deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and budget.

**Team Collaboration:**

* Work closely with business analysts, system administrators, and other IT professionals to deliver comprehensive solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior developers and IT staff, including adoption of AI-assisted development practices.
* Conduct training sessions and create documentation for end-users and technical teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Stay up-to-date with NetSuite updates and industry best practices to continuously enhance system functionality.
* Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and system optimization, including the application of AI-powered automation and agent-based workflows.

*And other duties as assigned.*

* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal

* NetSuite certification(s) such as SuiteFoundation, SuiteCloud Developer, or ERP Consultant.
* Experience with other ERP systems and integration platforms.
* Knowledge of accounting and finance principles.
* Experience with the ARM module within NetSuite.
* **Experience designing or deploying AI-powered automation solutions or agentic workflows within enterprise environments.**
* **Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen) or AI agent platforms.**

The engineer will work across Java services, distributed systems, Kafka, GitHub Actions, databases, scripting, cloud deployments, and production operations. Responsibilities

Work with SQL Server and other relational databases for data processing, validation, migrations, troubleshooting, query optimization, and operational support.
  
Deploy and support applications in GCP and other cloud environments, including configuration, service connectivity, secrets management, deployment automation, and runtime operations.
  
Implement observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerts, and diagnostic tooling across applications, pipelines, databases, and infrastructure.
  
Troubleshoot complex issues across application code, Kafka, GitHub Actions, scripts, databases, cloud infrastructure, networking, and deployment environments.
  
  
Performance, Quality, Security, and Reliability
  
  
Design and optimize services, APIs, event processing, database interactions, and automation for performance, scalability, and resource efficiency.
  
Develop appropriate unit, integration, contract, workflow, and end-to-end tests for new and modified functionality.
  
Apply secure engineering practices covering authentication, authorization, input validation, secrets, data protection, and least-privilege access.
  
Participate in production readiness reviews, incident response, root-cause analysis, defect resolution, and post-release stabilization.
